seasonseries.title: Seattle Sounders FC vs. Minnesota United FC

keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match because of an injury Kyle Duncan (Minnesota United FC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.

Goal! Seattle Sounders FC 1, Minnesota United FC 0. Jordan Morris (Seattle Sounders FC) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Albert Rusnák with a through ball.
Jefferson Díaz (Minnesota United FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Alex Roldan (Seattle Sounders FC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Seattle Sounders FC 2, Minnesota United FC 0. Hassani Dotson (Seattle Sounders FC) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner following a corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Kyle Duncan (Minnesota United FC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Seattle Sounders FC 2, Minnesota United FC 0.
Substitution, Minnesota United FC. Bongokuhle Hlongwane replaces Kyle Duncan.

Goal! Seattle Sounders FC 2, Minnesota United FC 1. Anthony Markanich (Minnesota United FC) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Bongokuhle Hlongwane with a cross following a fast break.
Owen Gene (Minnesota United FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
